title: Efficient synthesis of novel 1,10 phenanthroline-substituted imidazolium salts: Exploring their anticancer applications.
authors: Cakir, Sinem; Ilhan, Suleyman; Atmaca, Harika; Turkmen, Hayati
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新型菲咯啉取代咪唑盐的合成及其抗癌活性，仅涉及小分子与DNA的UV-Vis结合实验和与蛋白的分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study reports a new series of 1,10-phenanthroline-substituted imidazolium salts (1a-f), examining their design, synthesis, structure and anticancer activities. The structures of these salts (1a-f) were characterized using (1)H, (13)C NMR, elemental analysis, mass spectrometry and Fourier transform infrared (FT-IR) spectroscopies. The salts' cytotoxic activities were tested against cancer cell lines, specifically MCF-7, MDA-MB-231 and non-tumorigenic MCF-10A mammary cells. The study compared the impact of aliphatic and benzylic groups in the salts' structure on their anticancer activity. Screening results revealed that compound 1c, in particular, showed promising inhibitory activity against the growth of MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells, with an IC(50) value of 12.8 +/- 1.2 muM, indicating its potential as a chemotherapeutic agent. Cell apoptosis analysis demonstrated a tendency for compound 1c to induce early apoptosis in breast cancer cells. The stability/aquation of compound 1c was investigated using (1)H NMR spectroscopy and its binding modes with DNA were explored via UV-Vis spectroscopy. Additionally, the study investigated the interaction residues and docking scores of compound 1c and the reference drug doxorubicin against Bax and Bcl-2 proteins using molecular docking.
abstract_zh: 本研究报道了一系列新型1,10-菲咯啉取代的咪唑鎓盐（1a-f），探讨了其设计、合成、结构及抗癌活性。这些盐（1a-f）的结构通过(1)H、 (13)C NMR、元素分析、质谱和傅里叶变换红外（FT-IR）光谱进行了表征。盐的细胞毒性活性针对癌细胞系进行了测试，特别是MCF-7、MDA-MB-231以及非致瘤性MCF-10A乳腺细胞。研究比较了盐结构中脂肪族和苄基基团对其抗癌活性的影响。筛选结果显示，化合物1c尤其对MDA-MB-231乳腺癌细胞生长表现出有前景的抑制活性，其IC(50)值为12.8 +/- 1.2 muM，表明其作为化疗药物的潜力。细胞凋亡分析显示，化合物1c倾向于诱导乳腺癌细胞早期凋亡。通过(1)H NMR光谱研究了化合物1c的稳定性/水合作用，并通过UV-Vis光谱探讨了其与DNA的结合模式。此外，研究还利用分子对接方法调查了化合物1c和参考药物多柔比星与Bax和Bcl-2蛋白的相互作用残基及对接评分。
